decision: done = make verify-skills passes with a gate that compiles every kotlin block and runs every @Test under Robolectric, plus planted mistakes that the gate must catch

decision: pinned stable versions read from maven metadata today: Compose BOM 2026.09.00 (ui 1.12.1, material3 1.4.0), Robolectric 4.17, AGP 9.5.1, Kotlin 2.4.21, Gradle 9.4.1, coroutines-test 1.11.0, Roborazzi 1.78.0

decision: rigor high: real Gradle build per run, planted-mistake fixtures; scope ~30 reference files, web-only upstream topics (iframes, service workers, Electron, extensions) dropped
why: wrong testing advice silently spreads into every project that loads the skill; web topics have no Compose analogue

decision: built the Gradle harness first: AGP 9.5.1 + Gradle 9.9.1 wrapper, compileSdk 37, minSdk 24, targetSdk 36, allWarningsAsErrors
why: the riskiest unknown was whether this stack builds and runs Robolectric at all; AGP 9.5.1 failed on Gradle 9.4.1 (NoClassDefFoundError ProjectTypeBinding), Compose 1.12 needs compileSdk 37, navigation 2.10 needs minSdk 24

decision: added --add-opens=java.base/jdk.internal.access=ALL-UNNAMED to unit test JVM args
why: Robolectric 4.17 on JDK 25 failed every test with 'Failed to interact with raw FileDescriptor internals'; this is the documented workaround
result: smoke test green; becomes a common-errors entry

decision: found that Compose 1.12 deprecated createComposeRule/runComposeUiTest for v2 packages that use StandardTestDispatcher
why: the compiler flagged the v1 rule in the smoke test; my default examples would have taught a deprecated API
result: all examples must use v2; warnings are errors

decision: wrote the TS gate: kotlin blocks compile and their tests run in one Gradle build per check, kotlin compile-only compiles without running, kotlin snippet capped at 12 lines, fence languages allowlisted, every Maven coordinate must match a harness pin
why: the gate is the lever workers and reviewers rerun; pins stop examples from drifting from the versions that were verified

decision: planted fixtures caught two gate bugs before any content existed: package-line regex ate the next line (off-by-one line numbers), and Kotlin suppresses warnings when errors exist so deprecations needed their own fixture
why: a gate that passes too easily is suspect; plants prove each class of mistake is reported

decision: wrote SKILL.md router for 29 reference files across core, testing-patterns, debugging, architecture, infrastructure-ci-cd, and fanned them out to 5 poteto-agent workers by category
why: files are independent seams; each worker checks its own files with node tests/check.ts in its own harness copy, so no shared build state

decision: checked release notes: v2 test APIs arrived in Compose 1.11.0-alpha03; ComposeUiTestConfig is 1.13-alpha only, though the docs page already shows it
why: the official page describes APIs newer than the pinned 1.12.1; workers are told the harness decides

decision: a test-source Activity cannot be launched by Robolectric (not in manifest); gave the activities worker ownership of harness/blocks/src/main for a declared MainActivity
why: examples must be runnable; ComponentActivity works for everything else via ui-test-manifest
